name: Arba'a Turub
summary: Four-player Somali partnership Whist played with 144 cards made of four stripped 36-card packs.
rules_text: Four players in two fixed partnerships use 144 cards: four copies of A K Q J 10 9 8 7 6 in each suit. Determine first dealer by highest single card. Dealer shuffles, left cuts, deals 36 cards each in 3s clockwise. After the first 3 cards to player's left of dealer, that player looks and announces trump suit, then dealing resumes. Dealer must show last batch is 3 cards or redeal. Left of dealer leads first trick. Must follow suit if possible, else may trump or discard. Highest trump wins, else highest of led suit; if identical rank and suit duplicates are played, the earlier played counts higher. Winner leads next. Play 36 tricks. Partnership taking more tricks wins the game. A match requires a partnership to win two games where the second winning trick total exceeds the first; equal tricks or insufficient increase are draws. Stakes are taken by match winners.
